name: Firm-scoped (external partner) layout & data-resolution fixes
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-02 (with screenshots). After MDPF_SCOPED.S5 put external partner users (peter@inflectionwealth.com, firmId=inflection) onto firm-scoped views, a cluster of panel-visibility + data-load bugs surfaced that do NOT appear for internal/Opal users. CONFIRMED SINGLE ROOT CAUSE (not stale entitlement - firmId IS provisioned): _partners/inflection/index.tsx:154 sets firmOverride=undefined for external users; _shared consumers resolve firmId-scoped gates (panels/roles/tabs) + data fetches from firmOverride alone -> useTenantLayout(undefined) -> DEFAULT_LAYOUT(49F) + unscoped/failed fetches. Symptoms: (1) Role Composition panel wrongly renders for Inflection (49F-specific, should be suppressed via roles.composition.enabled=false); (2) Firm Overview panel absent for Peter but present for internal Andrew; (3) Book view 'Could not load book data' (49F dynamic-Lambda handler instead of Inflection static + unscoped fetch). This is the audit-sweep ADVI_INFMVP F1 flagged (F1 fixed the first instance in PartnerAnalytics the same way). Phases: P0 (RD, empirical confirm + full _shared sweep, sizes W1/W2 + decides FE-only-vs-needs-AE); W1 (RD, resolve firmId-scoped gates from firmId, durable = SHARED.006 two-param useTenantLayout(firmId,firmOverride?)); W2 (RD FE + AE conditional, route firm-scoped data for external users). REGRESSION MATRIX MANDATORY across 49F/demo/internal (asymmetric bug).
